source: AWS Price List API, service codes AmazonBedrock and AmazonBedrockFoundationModels, every region, matched to model ids from bedrock list-foundation-models and the bedrock-mantle model list in every enabled region
basis: On-demand standard (regional) input and output token rates, USD per 1,000 tokens. Excludes batch, reserved, flex, priority, long-context, latency-optimized, and prompt-cache rates. Where only a global rate is listed, that rate is used.
